capabilities: Import a Medium article by URL as a Markdown file
Add a Medium author and their articles to the vault
Sync new articles from previously added authors
Save the RapidAPI key in vault settings
extras: Warns that the API key is stored in vault settings and should be gitignored; notes a free RapidAPI plan with 150 requests per month at time of writing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Medium articles into a vault as Markdown files.

relations.evidence: It uses the Unofficial Medium API to fetch the articles
relations.plugin: Medium API (Unofficial Medium API via RapidAPI)

relations.evidence: If using Git plugin. Add .gitignore with .obsidian/plugins/medium-importer/data.json

requires.name: RapidAPI Medium API subscription (free plan available)

summary: Medium importer that fetches Medium articles by URL or author via an unofficial Medium API and saves them as Markdown files.
